metadata.description: The Daily checks Azure Monitor workbook, one tab per daily check. Same resource as main.bicep. Shape from Microsoft Learn's workbook ARM template sample and the Microsoft.Insights/workbooks 2023-06-01 reference. The name is a deterministic GUID (what-if can't evaluate newGuid()), so a redeploy updates the same workbook.
The workbook's name in the gallery; unique in the resource group and source.
The Sentinel Log Analytics workspace's resource ID: the workbook shows under that workspace's Workbooks.
The gallery template with this environment's workspace and parameter values, as the kit's plan writes it.
